events.title: First Battle of St Albans
events.description: Richard, Duke of York, and his allies defeated the forces of King Henry VI at St Albans in England, killing several leading Lancastrian nobles, including the Duke of Somerset.
events.significance: Often considered the opening battle of the Wars of the Roses, the dynastic conflict between the houses of Lancaster and York that reshaped English politics for three decades.

events.title: Birth of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
events.description: Arthur Conan Doyle was born in Edinburgh, Scotland. A physician by training, he went on to write the Sherlock Holmes stories, first appearing in 1887.
events.significance: His creation of Sherlock Holmes shaped modern detective fiction and established conventions of the genre that endure today.

events.title: Wright Brothers Granted Patent for Flying Machine
events.description: The U.S. Patent Office issued patent No. 821,393 to Orville and Wilbur Wright for their flying machine, which covered their system of aerodynamic control using wing warping and a rudder.
events.significance: The patent recognized the Wrights' key innovations in controlled flight and became the basis of long legal battles over early aviation technology.

events.title: Valdivia Earthquake in Chile
events.description: The most powerful earthquake ever recorded, with a magnitude of about 9.5, struck near Valdivia in southern Chile, triggering tsunamis that crossed the Pacific and hit Hawaii, Japan, and the Philippines.
events.significance: It killed thousands of people, left millions homeless, and led to improved tsunami warning systems and advances in seismology.

events.title: Ceylon Becomes the Republic of Sri Lanka
events.description: Ceylon adopted a new constitution, severed its remaining constitutional ties to the British monarchy, and was renamed Sri Lanka, with a president as head of state.
events.significance: The change marked the full break from colonial-era status and reflected rising nationalism, though it also deepened tensions that contributed to later ethnic conflict.
